# MaterializeSpecMetadata

## Rules
- Input: `specId`, `policy?: 'if-needed'|'force'` (default if-needed). Result: metadata, metadataFingerprint, source persisted|generated, regenerated, warnings.
- if-needed: read snapshot+artifacts+lock; fresh → return persisted; else generate; re-read fingerprint before persist; mismatch → refuse write; PersistSpecMetadata with observed revision; return generated even if persist fails (non-conflict).
- force: always regenerate+persist; persist failure reported to caller (for RegenerateSpecMetadata).
- Revision conflict: re-read winner — if fresh return persisted; else ≤1 bounded retry; else typed conflict. Source change mid-flight → no write.
- Reuse GenerateSpecMetadata hashes (no second hash). if-needed cache-write fail (non-conflict) → success + `metadata-cache-write-failed` warning + one Logger.warn; callers propagate warning.
- No public missing/invalid/stale statuses. Composition: resolveMaterializeSpecMetadataDeps → SpecRepository, GenerateSpecMetadata, PersistSpecMetadata, Logger. On Kernel.specs as `materializeMetadata`.

## Constraints
- Sole freshness/regen orchestrator. No self-derived deps/opts/schema. Max one concurrency retry.
